Design Engineer - Studio Team

Restream is looking for a Design Engineer to build features that are well crafted and easy to use.

What You'll Do
Craft every detail of new product features, from an idea to design to the implementation
Design and implement the UI and UX of new and existing features
Give and receive code review feedback with the team

What We Look For
Deep understanding of the UX design process
Proficient with Figma or another design and prototyping tool
A strong portfolio of previous design projects
Knowledge of React and TypeScript

What We Offer
A startup environment and a flat company structure
Work closely with the founders to grow the product
